headline: Andrew Yule & Co. Ltd. files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure for Veedol Corporation Limited
sum: Andrew Yule & Co. Ltd. submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) to NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Veedol Corporation Limited. The filing initiates the formal regulatory notification process for the transaction.
detail: Andrew Yule & Co. Ltd. filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Veedol Corporation Limited. Under SEBI's Takeover Code (2011), an acquirer must disclose within 2 trading days of crossing 5% shareholding (or upon acquisition of 2% by a person already holding 5%+). This disclosure is the threshold notification—the acquirer is now obligated to issue an open offer if it has crossed or intends to cross 26% of voting capital, or if other trigger conditions are met. The specific shareholding position, offer price, and timeline for the open offer would be detailed in a separate open offer document subject to SEBI approval.
